page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 12 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped from 6 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and relies on a KVM hypervisor. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across most compute and memory workloads. The single-core Geekbench score is 1614.0, while the multi-core score reaches 7921.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 639.69 GB/sec, dropping to 82.85 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In database operations, the server achieves a Passmark database score of 6125.12 and handles Redis SET operations at 11.97 million operations per second. For language model tasks, prompt processing with a medium 7B model is relatively weak at 24.38 tokens per second, though text generation for the same model averages 9.84 tokens per second.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.r7se.3xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The absence of bundled local storage means users must attach network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. Given its high memory capacity relative to compute cores, this instance is well-suited for memory-cached databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and general-purpose workloads requiring substantial memory overhead without demanding extreme CPU performance.
